problem_type: The paid card showed and sent references connected on the canvas only when the host's shot was already in a mode with reference slots; a reference removed on the card came back on the next render; and removing one on the card went through the canvas's own remove path and deleted the canvas edge
symptom: Full walk pb02 (2026-10-02): the person connected a reference photo to the placeholder of an Agent-drafted image shot and pressed Generate this one on the paid card. The card said 'Text to image' and showed no reference; the provider received 0 references although the canvas showed the connection (sent-references-on-canvas). Removing a canvas-connected reference on the card did not stick: the next render put it back and it was sent anyway. The card's composer also treated the canvas edges of the placeholder as its own, so the × on such a reference disconnected the edge on the canvas before anything was generated.
direct_cause: src/workbench/ai/v4/spendCardDraft.ts projectSpendNode built the card node in the host shot's mode (gpt-image-2 t2i, no reference slots) and then placed the canvas references into it, so applySpendReferences had no slot and dropped them; useAgentPanelSpendConfirm read the canvas references from the placed canvas node's own slots. Edits on the card were diffed against the host shot (candidatePatchFromNode without a baseline), so removing a canvas reference or switching the promoted mode back looked identical to the host's copy and recorded nothing. The card node took the placeholder's id (projectSpendNode: id = shot.nodeId), so NodeParameterControls resolved the live canvas edges as the card node's own fills and decideArrayReferenceRemoval answered disconnect-edge, which NodeParameterControls executes with the store's disconnectEdge directly, outside the write-access seam.
class_root: Which mode can consume the live reference edges of a node has one rule on the canvas (resolveModeForConnectedReferences, applied when an edge is created, when the model changes and at submit), but the paid card became a fourth consumer of canvas references without applying it; and once canvas references became part of the card's default projection, the card's edit ledger kept diffing against the host's copy instead of the card the person started from. The card editor shared the placeholder's identity, so canvas-structure logic in the shared composer acted on the canvas from the panel host.
affected_population: Agent-drafted image shots whose default mode is text-only (for example GPT Image 2 text to image) with a reference connected on the canvas
Any paid card where the person removes a canvas-connected reference or switches the mode the card aligned for it
entry_points: The card's Generate: useAgentPanelSpendCard.primary -> IPC hand-over-spend -> canvasHandOver -> renderer production.hand-over-shots -> handOverShotsOp -> runGenerationNodesByPlan -> runGenerationNode (reconcileNodeModeWithConnectedReferences at submit, the node's own path)
Landing a drafted shot or an Agent revision: multiShotCanvasLanding -> landedShotIntent.placeLandedReferences -> planReferenceProjection
Adding or removing a reference: on the canvas node (edges, NodeParameterControls); the card has no reference controls
internal_only_reason: Which reference edges a generation node consumes and which mode receives them is Nomi's own canvas rule over its own model archetypes; no third-party library decides it.

invariant_owner_layer.why: resolveModeForConnectedReferences is the only rule for which mode receives the live reference edges; the canvas applies it at edge creation, model change and submit, landing applies it through planReferenceProjection, and the paid card no longer has a projection of its own: it hands the node to the same submit.

invariants: A reference connected on the canvas to a paid shot's node is sent, in a mode that can receive it, chosen by the canvas's own rule, because the card sends the node through the canvas engine.
There is no card-side copy of the shot: the card shows the node (pointer plus read-only summary) and edits nothing; canvas references reach the request only through the node.
Removing a canvas reference happens on the node through the canvas's own remove path; the card cannot remove or re-add one.
What is sent is the node as it is when the canvas dispatches it.

door_reduction.why_not: The mode rule keeps one owner (resolveModeForConnectedReferences) read by the canvas's own moments (edge, model change, auto-select, submit, delivery) and by the landing projection; the card's doors (placeSpendReferences, keptReferenceUrls, draftAfterNodeEdit, canvasReferenceInputs, findNodeResultUrl) are deleted. What is added is the landing chain calling planReferenceProjection and the hand-over dispatching through runGenerationNodesByPlan.

generality_proof: The card no longer aligns anything: it hands the node to the canvas submit, which aligns the mode for any archetype and slot kind the canvas aligns for (image references, first and last frames, video and audio references) and for every model, without a model-specific branch; landing uses the same rule through planReferenceProjection.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Projects the candidate's references onto the landed node, add-only: an edge for canvas results, a slot value otherwise, mode aligned by the canvas rule; first landing and Agent revisions both call it (landedShotIntent.placeLandedReferences).

The card's Generate hands the shot to the canvas engine (runGenerationNodesByPlan -> runGenerationNode), which sends exactly what the node holds: its own references and its live canvas edges, the mode reconciled at submit like the node's own ↑.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Dispatches through runGenerationNodesByPlan with the node's live graph (productionHandOverShotsOp.test.ts; draft -> node -> request parity matrix).
Runs at every node submit, the card's hand-over included (the same runGenerationNode).
First landing and Agent revisions place candidate references through planReferenceProjection (landedShotIntent.test.ts).
A model change on the node keeps using the same rule.
Creates an edge only with the canvas connect capability; the panel host that lacked it is deleted with the old card.

recurrence.reason: Any surface that keeps its own copy of a shot (the old card did) can drift from the node it is meant to send; the copy is deleted, so a new one would have to be added on purpose.
same_class_scan: node scripts/door-map.mjs --write=planReferenceProjection,reconcileNodeModeWithConnectedReferences,placeLandedReferences --read=resolveModeForConnectedReferences (2026-10-24: 9 doors, none in the Agent panel)
depcruise chat-card-no-import-node-editor: chat cards cannot import the node composer or its parameter controls

prevention.invariant: A paid shot's references are the node's: candidate references land on the node through planReferenceProjection with the canvas mode rule, and the card hands the node to the canvas submit, which reconciles the mode with the live edges.
prevention.failure_mode: A candidate reference the host cannot resolve to a project address is not placed (logged), so the node, and what is sent, shows it missing instead of sending something else.
prevention.strategy: Delete the card's own projection, land candidate references on the node once, and send through the canvas engine.

legacy_paths.rationale: 2026-10-24, deleted with the old card: the card's own node (projectSpendNode / placeSpendReferences / candidatePatchFromNode / keptReferenceUrls / draftAfterNodeEdit). The node on the canvas is the only copy.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No third-party dependency decides reference slots or modes.

migration: No stored data changes. A card ledger saved by the previous build was relative to the host shot; read against the default card it applies the same fields, so a saved prompt or parameter edit is kept. 2026-10-24 D2 step 3 (design card docs/plan/2026-10-23-d2-pointer-spend-card.md; contract docs/fixes/2026-10-24-spend-card-one-engine.root-cause.json): the paid card became node pointers plus a read-only summary that hands its shots to the canvas engine; the card's own node projection (projectSpendNode / placeSpendReferences / candidatePatchFromNode) was deleted with the old card, so this contract's boundaries, doors, tests and legacy paths were re-pointed to the code that holds the invariant today (problem, symptom, causes and class root above are the original record).
residual_risks: Edge-backed parameter references (parameter image slots wired by canvas edges) follow the node's own submit path; the card shows them only as part of the node pointer.

A candidate reference the host can no longer resolve at landing (asset removed from the project between the draft and the landing) is not placed on the node (logged); nothing tells the Agent in that turn.
